scenario_description:
Objective: Bring the SeaGlow fluorescence carry-on kit to the San Diego conference so the hands-on light station can be shown during morning setup.
Emerging Need: No equipment approval is needed while the session format and kit choice are unsettled; it becomes a missing prerequisite once the specific battery-powered kit is staged for the booked flight.
Decision Context: The viable preparation depends on joining the airline queue notice with stored packing rules and the active booking reference, not on the conference messages alone.
Consequence: After the preclearance queue closes, travel can continue, but the UV battery kit cannot be approved for that departure.

parameter.title: San Diego Pacific Educators Conference travel block
parameter.description: Mainland conference travel for the reef education outreach presentation; equipment details still pending.

parameter.subject: Your San Diego session is now a hands-on light demonstration
parameter.body: Your reef education session has been assigned a hands-on coral fluorescence demo table. The room opens for presenter setup at 07:45 PDT on October 28, with attendees entering at 09:30. Please plan for a tabletop light station if your travel kit supports it; final equipment selection remains up to you.

parameter.content: I staged the SeaGlow fluorescence carry-on kit for the San Diego demo. The case tag reads 'mainland fluorescence carry-on kit,' and the printed spec sheet matches the travel packing notes. It will be on the office pickup shelf by Monday afternoon.

parameter.subject: Lithium device preclearance queue for October 27 HNL-SAN departures
parameter.body: For October 27 HNL-SAN departures, special-services preclearance for large lithium battery devices is open now and closes Friday, October 23 at 16:00 HST because of weekend staffing. Requests must include passenger legal name, record locator, device model, and battery watt-hours. Unapproved large spare batteries will not be accepted at check-in.

parameter.subject: October 27 HNL-SAN lithium device queue closed
parameter.body: The preclearance queue for large lithium battery devices on October 27 HNL-SAN departures closed at 16:00 HST today. New approvals cannot be added for that departure. Standard carry-on rules still apply to ordinary electronics and non-battery presentation materials.
